summary: Comstock Holding Companies filed an 8-K regarding the formation of a 50/50 joint venture, Oklahoma AI Ventures LLC, with Eagle Road Oil, LLC to develop land in Oklahoma for AI and data center campuses. The filing constitutes a routine entry into a material definitive agreement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other transformative event is described. The joint venture involves capital commitments and standard governance provisions. There are no deal terms such as price per share or premium. The filing is a standard disclosure of a business arrangement without triggering a special-situation classification.
